name: Splice
tagline: Turn-based territory on hexagons: grow or jump, and win over every neighbour where you land.
rules:
Splice is played in turns on a board of hexagons, by two or three players. Each
starts with two or three pieces, and the player with the most pieces at the end
wins.

## A move

On your turn, pick one of your pieces and an empty cell near it:

- **Grow** into a cell next to it: a new piece appears there, and the piece you
  picked stays where it is.
- **Jump** to a cell two steps away: the piece moves there and leaves its old
  cell empty. A jump goes over anything in between, holes included.

Then every other player's piece next to the cell you moved into becomes yours.

Magenta moves first, then Cyan, then Amber. A player who has no move (no empty
cell within two steps of any of their pieces) misses their turn.

## The end

- The game ends when at most one player can still move. The empty cells left
  become that player's pieces. So a full board ends it, and so does a player
  losing every piece.
- The player with the most pieces wins. Players with as many pieces share
  their place.
- A turn takes as long as its player thinks, and the match clock stops at half
  an hour. If it does, the player with the most pieces wins.

## Strategy

Growing gains a piece; jumping doesn't, and leaves a hole that an opponent can
grow into, next to your pieces. A piece next to an empty cell can be won over by
the next player, so the strongest moves often fill a gap rather than win the
most pieces now.

themes.name: Petri Dish
themes.description: Stained cells growing on pale agar, under the lab's lamp.

themes.name: Fluorescence
themes.description: Glowing cells in the dark, as a fluorescence microscope shows them.

maps.name: Honeycomb
maps.description: The open hexagon, with three holes across its middle. Three pieces each, on alternate corners.

maps.name: Atoll
maps.description: A ring of cells round a lagoon: the fight goes round it, or jumps across its narrow shore.

maps.name: Rift
maps.description: Two halves split by a rift that only a jump crosses, but for a cell at each end. Each player starts on both sides.

maps.name: Trefoil
maps.description: Three players on the hexagon, two opposite corners each, round three holes in the middle.

bots.name: Careful
bots.description: Takes the most pieces it can once the next player has replied as well as they can.

bots.name: Greedy
bots.description: Takes the most pieces it can this move, without a thought for the reply. The leaderboard's fixed point: it is rated 1000.

bots.name: Monte Carlo
bots.description: Monte Carlo tree search: it tries the most promising moves, plays each line on a couple of moves greedily, and keeps exploring the lines that turn out best for whoever chose them.

bots.name: Minimax
bots.description: Searches four moves ahead with alpha-beta, its own and the next three whoever makes them, assuming everyone else plays their best against it.

bots.name: Random
bots.description: Makes any legal move, each as likely as the others.
